newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI eyes strategic partner for steel unit.
newsitem.headline: DMCI eyes strategic partner for steel unit.

text.p: Philippine construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc said on Monday it was scouting for a strategic partner to transform its subsidiary Atlantic, Gulf and Pacific Co (AG&P) of Manila Inc into a regional steel fabrication company.
DMCI, in a paper submitted to the Philippine Stock Exchange, said it is reorganising AG&P to focus on its core business of heavy steel fabrication.
It said the corporate reorganisation could attract large investors in developing AG&P into a leading steel fabrication company in the region.
DMCI had invested 333 million pesos last year for the reorganisation.
